title: Camp Fortune
specs: State of the art snowmaking and grooming for excellent ski conditions
Aerial park features continuous lifelines and multiple zip lines
Season pass or lift ticket required in addition to lesson fee
Helmets strongly recommended but not included in rental packages; available for rent or purchase
Minimum age 5 for Ski-Wee program; must be mobile with equipment on
Aerial park minimum height 1.35 m for children’s course, 1.75 m for explorer course
Maximum weight 250 lbs for aerial park
Waiver required for aerial park; parental signature required for under 16
School groups minimum size 20; adult supervisors ski free at 1:10 ratio
Corporate events and banquets available with catering and AV facilities

blurb: Camp Fortune provides ski and snowboard lessons for adults and kids, rental equipment, an aerial park with zip lines, and facilities for corporate and private events. Lessons are offered in multi-week programs with required season passes. The aerial park has height and weight restrictions and requires a waiver.
